PlayerAccount.title: PlayerAccount
PlayerAccount.description: Private player profile, one-time company name change state, and serialized game state payload.

uid.description: Immutable Firebase Auth UID of the player.

companyNameChangeUsed.description: True once the player has used their single permitted company name change.

gameState.description: Native structured map of the player's complete simulation state.

stagingGameState.description: Optional staging simulation state for admin candidate testing.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the account was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last save.

PlayerPrivateInfo.title: PlayerPrivateInfo
PlayerPrivateInfo.description: Isolated PII document storing the player's verified email address.

ReleaseControl.title: ReleaseControl
ReleaseControl.description: Global release management state separating public approved version from admin candidate version.

history.description: Bounded list (max 20) of approved release snapshots for rollback.

/players/{userId}.description: Player account and simulation state isolated strictly per authenticated user.

/players/{userId}/private/{docId}.description: Isolated PII subcollection for player email.

/release_control/{configId}.description: Global release control metadata readable by players and writable strictly by verified admin.
